name: EVERY-2 scheme with greedy optimization
definition: A parallel multiresolution volume rendering algorithm that uses a greedy optimization strategy to select which wavelet tree nodes store pre-reconstructed data, trading storage space for rendering speed while maintaining load balance across processors.
summary: The EVERY-2 scheme with greedy optimization is a parallel multiresolution volume rendering algorithm that selects wavelet nodes for pre-reconstruction based on a benefit function to trade storage for speed.
